Sh＊nda★★★★★ October 2024 · Garden room

I had the most incredible time staying with Nene and Minho <3. I was an English teacher in Suwon for two years and this was my first time back in ten years. I absolutely plan on staying here every time I come back to Korea, I had the best stay:
- Nene and Minho were super communicative and helpful with my arrival, they stayed up to welcome me in, even though I arrived quite late
- They were so helpful with local recommendations and buying tickets (they bought my tickets to go see a baseball game, helped me with getting a bus ticket to the airport)
- They were both so fun to talk to and had really interesting travel stories to share
- The location is absolutely perfect, a super trendy area and right next to the Suwon Fortress, one of my favorite places to visit in Seoul/Suwon. I went on a walk to a cafe with Nene one morning and she was able to share some of the history of Suwon that I was unfamiliar with
- The breakfasts every morning were amazing, traditional home-cooked Korean food!

Ji＊oung★★★★★ April 2024 · Alley room

I’ve visited the place when the hosts operated a brunch restaurant at the same location. It was a beautiful place at that time so I was so excited to visit there after it’s renovated as an accommodation.
The place was wayyyyyy beyond my expectation! It literally blew my mind. I couldn’t believe they did interior on their own! The layout, color scheme, and attention to detail in every small item placed throughout the space were impressive.
I was with a friend from the UK so we need some background to explain to him. The host speaks English well and super knowledgeable in historical background of the city of Suwon and Hwaseong (temp palace in Joseon dynasty), which was even educational for me too!
And they serve Korean style breakfast in the morning, made with quality ingredients. The scent of perilla seeds oil they used for side dishes was so aromatic! She’s a good chef!
I'm so grateful for the warm welcome and thoughtful consideration during my stay. I’ll be back again for sure! ❤️

처음부터 반갑게 맞이해주시며 웰컴푸드와 편안한 분위기를 만들어주신 덕분에 방 안에서도 너무나 편안하게 휴식할 수 있었습니다😊(다양한 숙소를 다녀봤는데 이렇게 편한 침대는 너무 오랜만이었어요.. 몸 배기거나 그런 것도 없고 베개, 이불, 메트리스가 삼박자가 너무 잘맞아 하루 더 자고 싶었다는)

배달 음식도 시켜먹더라도 편안하게 먹을 수 있도록 그릇이나 식기를 준비해주시고, 하나하나 불편함 없이 살펴주셔 감사했습니다♡ 직접 클레스 해주시는 전통주도 맛보게 해주시고 잠깐의 시간이었지만 청주에 대한 역사까지 알게 되었던 시간이었어요!

또, 친구는 고양이 집사이기에 시작된 이야기가 좋아하는 취미생활까지 이어지며 첫 만남인게 인색할 정도로 즐거운 수다도 즐겨보고, 예쁜 고양이들의 역사(?)도 들어보면서 숙소에서 가장 힐링된 시간이 아니었나 싶을 정도로 즐거운 담소시간이었어요🥰

통창으로 되어있는 창문으로 바라보는 경치에 마음이 편안해지고, 창가에 비치된 여러 종류의 책을 숙박기간이 하루가 아니었다면 천천히 읽어보고 싶었는데 아쉽네요ㅜ 다음에 가서 꼭 읽어볼께요 ㅎㅎ

주변에 사람들도 많이 지나다니지 않고 한적한 공간이라 너무 편안했고, 바로 옆에 행궁스팟들이 있어 접근성도 용이했습니다! 통창에는 블라인드가 설치되어 있으니 필요한 경우에는 내려서 프라이빗하게 사용해보기도 하였어요!

많이 지쳐있던 한 주였기에 어떻게 해야 무거운 마음과 피로를 풀 수 있을까 하였는데 이곳 덕분에 잊지 못할 소중한 추억과 힐링을 낭낭하게 하고 갑니다♡

시루, 담이, 딱지 등 말랑콩떡 귀여운 고양이들과 하나하나 신경쓴 공간과 아이들을 보듬어주시는 사장님들의 따뜻한 마음에 감동하고 갑니다🫶

정성스러운 아침과 차, 따사로운 햇살까지 완벽한 하루를 만들어 주셔서 너무나 감사드립니다! 재방문 의지가 아주 강한 숙소임을 알려드리며 우연이라도 이 숙소를 발견하게 된다면 당신은 럭키휴먼...

You answered my questions so kindly even before the stay that, although it was my first time here, I came without any worry~

You greeted us warmly from the very start and created such a relaxed atmosphere with welcome food that we could rest completely at ease in the room too😊 (I've stayed at all kinds of places, and it's been ages since I slept in a bed this comfortable.. nothing digging into my back, and the pillow, duvet and mattress were such a perfect trio that I wanted to stay one more night)

Even when we ordered delivery, you set out bowls and cutlery so we could eat comfortably, and you looked after every little thing so nothing was ever inconvenient — thank you♡ You also let us taste the traditional liquor you teach in your own class, and in that short time I even learned about the history of cheongju!

Also, my friend is a cat parent, so a chat that started there carried on into our favourite hobbies — we had so much fun chatting that calling it a first meeting feels stingy, and hearing the history (?) of the pretty cats made it such a lovely talk that it might have been the most healing time of the whole stay🥰

The view through the big floor-to-ceiling windows put my mind at ease, and if we'd stayed more than one night I'd have loved to slowly read the many books set out by the window — such a shame Next time I'll definitely read them haha

Hardly anyone walks by and it's a quiet spot, so it was really relaxing, and the Haenggung sights are right next door, so it's easy to get around! The big windows have blinds, so we lowered them when we wanted and had the room all to ourselves!

It had been a really draining week and I'd been wondering how to shake off the heavy heart and the tiredness, but thanks to this place I'm leaving with unforgettable, precious memories and plenty of healing♡

I'm leaving touched by the squishy, adorable cats — Siru, Dami, Ttakji and the rest — by a space where every detail was cared for, and by the warm hearts of the hosts who look after the little ones🫶

Thank you so much for a perfect day, with a breakfast made with such care, tea and warm sunshine! Let me tell you this is a place I very much want to come back to, and if you stumble on it, even by chance, you're a lucky human...

희＊★★★★★ August 2025 · Alley room

행궁동을 떠올리면 어느 맛집이나 카페보다 스테이 이고가 제일 먼저 떠올라요.
앞으로 수원에 갈 일 있을 때마다 스테이 이고에서 묵을 것 같아요. 그만큼 너무 좋았습니다. 스테이이고 후기와 평점이 너무 좋아 기대하고 갔는데 기대 이상, 그 이상이었습니다.
스테이 이고 - 에어비앤비계의 유노윤호(대충이란없다.)

1. 위치 최상 - 행궁동 핫플 도보 5분 내 다 가능...근데 너무 시끄럽지 않고 고즈넉한 느낌.
"이게 가능한가요? 예. 스테이 이고에서는 가능합니다. "
창 밖 보고 있으면 어디 멀리 떠나온 듯해서 기분이 좋았어요.
조금만 걸어나오면 행궁 맛집, 카페 다 갈 수 있어요! 창문 밖으로 보이는 한옥뷰도 좋았습니다.

2. 숙소 컨디션 최상 - '와 청소를 어떻게 이렇게 하시지?' 싶을 정도로 방이 너무 좋았어요. 화장실도, 바닥, 침구도 모두 진짜 깨끗해서 사장님이 청소계 유노윤호인가...(대충이란 없음) 잠시 생각했습니다. 덕분에 근심, 걱정없이 꿀잠잤습니다.


3. 사장님 부부 진짜 최고 - 가기 전에 혹시 주변 맛집 정보 알려주실 수 있나 하고 메시지 드렸거든요. 얼마 지나지 않아 사장님께 메시지 왔는데 보고 깜-짝 놀랐습니다. 행궁동 맛집, 카페 정보 보내주시는데 진짜 행궁동 로컬만 아는, 광고아닌 진짜 꿀 정보...
감각있는 사장님 부부가 큐레이션한 행궁동 진짜 맛집, 클래식한 카페에서부터 최신 갬성 반영한 카페까지...
원래 나만 알고 싶을 때 많잖아요. 좋은 거 나만 알고, 예쁜 거 나만 입고... 근데 사장님 부부는.. 이런 정보 다 퍼주셔도 되나... 싶을 정도로 알려주셔서.. 진짜 감동...

4. 조식맛집 스테이이고
포슬포슬한 계란말이, 따뜻한 국물, 맛있는 반찬.
속 편하고 든든하게 맛있는 한 끼 먹었습니다. 여기가 행궁동 맛집.

하고 싶은 말 너무 많지만 숙소 선택할 때 뭐가 제일 중요할까 생각하다 짧게 남깁니다.
진짜 닮고 싶은 부부, 취향 짙고 따뜻한 사장님 덕분에 제대로 쉬고 갑니다! 감사해요

When I think of Haenggung-dong, Stay Eego comes to mind before any restaurant or café.
From now on, I think I'll stay at Stay Eego every time I go to Suwon. That's how good it was. The reviews and ratings were so good that I went in with high expectations, and it went beyond them, way beyond.
Stay Eego – the U-Know Yunho of Airbnb (there's no such thing as half-hearted).

1. Location: the best – every Haenggung-dong hotspot within a 5-minute walk... and yet not too noisy, with a calm, tranquil feel.
"Is that even possible? Yes. At Stay Eego, it is."
Looking out the window I felt like I'd travelled somewhere far away, and it put me in such a good mood.
Walk out just a little and you can get to all the Haenggung restaurants and cafés! The hanok view from the window was lovely too.

2. Condition of the place: the best – the room was so good I kept thinking, 'Wow, how do they clean like this?' The bathroom, the floor, the bedding were all genuinely spotless, so for a moment I wondered whether the host is the U-Know Yunho of cleaning... (no half-measures). Thanks to that, I slept like a baby without a care in the world.


3. The host couple are seriously the best – before going, I sent a message asking if they could maybe share some good places to eat nearby. Not long after, a message came back, and I was totally blown away when I saw it. They sent restaurant and café info for Haenggung-dong that only real locals know – not ads, real insider tips...
Haenggung-dong's real-deal restaurants curated by a couple with great taste, from classic cafés to cafés with the latest vibe...
You know how you often want to keep things to yourself? Keep the good stuff to yourself, wear the pretty things only yourself... But this couple.. shared so much that I wondered, are they really okay giving all this away... Honestly so touched...

4. Stay Eego, a breakfast destination
Fluffy rolled omelette, warm soup, delicious side dishes.
I had a tasty meal that was gentle on the stomach and really filling. This is the place to eat in Haenggung-dong.

There's so much more I want to say, but I thought about what matters most when choosing a place to stay and kept it short.
Thanks to a couple I truly want to be like, and warm hosts with real taste, I'm leaving properly rested! Thank you

An＊ie-Claire★★★★★ September 2024 · Garden room

J'ai passé un séjour exceptionnel chez mes hôtes Nene & Minho à Suwon ! Ils sont tout simplement adorables et attentionnés, toujours prêts à rendre le séjour agréable.
Les petits déjeuners coréens préparés et servis tous les matins, sont délicieux, un vrai régal pour commencer la journée.
La maison, avec son charmant jardin, est un véritable havre de paix.
La chambre, très bien décorée , lumineuse et avec vue sur le jardin, est un lieu de repos parfait.
Le quartier est extrêmement calme et la literie très confortable.
La propreté est irréprochable, et la localisation est idéale : à un pas du palais Hwaseong, du musée SUMA , des murailles et du marché Nammun.
Le quartier est vivant, tout en étant résidentiel avec de nombreux cafés, salons de thés et restaurants à découvrir et plusieurs K-dramas y ont été tournés.
Sans aucun doute, l'un de mes meilleurs séjours en Airbnb. Je recommande vivement si vous venez à Suwon, c’est ici qu’il faut venir.
Idéal pour solo traveler.

I had an exceptional stay with my hosts Nene & Minho in Suwon! They are simply lovely and thoughtful, always ready to make your stay a pleasant one.
The Korean breakfasts, cooked and served every morning, are delicious, a real treat to start the day.
The house, with its charming garden, is a true haven of peace.
The room, beautifully decorated, bright and looking onto the garden, is a perfect place to rest.
The area is extremely quiet and the bed very comfortable.
The cleanliness is spotless, and the location is ideal: a stone's throw from Hwaseong Palace, the SUMA museum, the walls and Nammun Market.
The neighbourhood is lively while still residential, with lots of cafés, tea rooms and restaurants to discover, and several K-dramas were filmed there.
Without a doubt, one of my best Airbnb stays. I highly recommend it: if you're coming to Suwon, this is the place to stay.
Ideal for solo travellers.

After the frenzy of Seoul, staying with Nene and Minho is a wise choice.
The welcome, for me, is exceptional. This couple goes out of their way to make your stay unforgettable.
The room is spacious and clean with a very good bed, and a green setting at the front of the house. And it's quiet. A treat for resting.
The breakfasts are delicious, generous and homemade by Nene, served with a lovely matcha carefully prepared by Minho.
The house is inside the fortress walls, so you can do everything on foot. The area is buzzing with cafés with charming atmospheres, good restaurants and all sorts of cute little shops. Buses can take you further afield if you like, or else a taxi that Nene can call for you.
She is always generous with recommendations for sights to visit and her favourite spots.
There's a lot to see in Suwon.
My stay was a magical interlude. I'll be very happy to come back.

Vi ble så rørt av den vennlige, imøtekommende og autentiske atmosfæren vi kjente på når vi ankom. Vi er så takknemlige for invitasjonen til å spise middag sammen med det andre gjesteparet og med vertskapet. Den muligheten ga oss en helt unik følelse og et minne for livet. Vertskapet balanserte bruken av koreansk og engelsk på en perfekt måte for oss som er et internasjonalt par. De skapte en veldig behagelig relasjon med oss som vi er veldig takknemlige for.

Ou stay with Minho and Nene in Suwon was truly wonderful. The room was beautiful and, in my opinion, would look charming in any season, with its cozy view over the street. Everything was spotless and carefully prepared, and they made us feel completely at home from the moment we arrived.

마지막으로 귀한 현지인 맛집과 산책로를 자세히 알려주셔서 갈 곳을 안 정하고 왔었는데 도움이 정말 많이 됐어요ㅎㅎㅎ 행궁동에서 노는 것보다 이곳에 머무르고 싶어 다시 갈 것 같아요🥹❤️

해외 생활하실 때 홈스테이 경험이 가장 기억에 남아 홈스테이를 하고 싶으셨다는 네네님 말씀처럼 저 역시 홈스테이는 처음이었는데 정말 좋은 기억으로 남았어요. 평화롭고 행복한 휴가를 보낼 수 있게 친절히 대해주신 두 분 정말 감사드려요! 다음에 또 놀러갈게요~~!!🥰

This place is magical!! It’s really close to the busy streets, but from the hill leading up to it, it feels like another world — so quiet and peaceful — so you get peace and food-hunting at the same time. What a great place! The convenience store is close too, and it was lovely for an evening walk.

The hosts are especially kind and so easy to talk to that even as an introvert I could chat comfortably and have fun haha. Like good people attract good people, with hosts this good the guests who come must be wonderful too~ The guestbook is full of beautiful lines, it felt like reading a book of poems :)

There’s a parking space too, so no worries about parking.

And they make breakfast themselves — it was so much tastier and healthier than anything you could buy, it made me rethink my delivery-only diet 🥲 The food is really, really delicious!!! I thought they’re a couple with a lot to learn from, living a really lovely life haha

Also the garden in front of the house is gorgeous — just sitting in the room quietly looking out the window was healing in itself. The view from the room was so pretty I almost begrudged the time spent going out. Before the trip I planned to read in cafés during the day, but I fell for the view from the room and spent about half of each day inside :) It looks just like the photos, but it’s even better in person!!

Lastly, they told us in detail about precious local favourite restaurants and walking routes, which helped so much since I came without deciding where to go haha I think I’ll go back just to stay here, more than to go out in Haenggung-dong 🥹❤️

Nene said her homestay experiences while living abroad were what she remembered most, which is why she wanted to run a homestay — it was my first homestay too, and it’s become a really good memory. Thank you both so much for being so kind and giving me such a peaceful, happy holiday! I’ll come visit again~~!!🥰

The shower room has everything, so I turned up with just a toothbrush and a change of clothes and wasn't inconvenienced at all
I feel like it would feel different every season, so this place has me itching to come back!!
The recommendations for good food and places to see nearby were great too, so I'm going to tick them off one by one!
I spotted lots of the genuinely great places I'd seen while coming and going around Haenggung-dong, so I loved the recommendation list
I enjoyed breakfast sooo much too!
A healthy, hearty meal first thing in the morning, and I could enjoy the rest of the day too!! (Even I, a picky eater, cleared my plate, it was that delicious, something cosy and nostalgic about it..)
The tea and ice cream they gave us for dessert were wonderful too. It was nice to sip a cup of tea calmly looking outside and sort out my thoughts for a moment, and eating ice cream for a sugar boost while having a little chat was so much fun!
Talking with the hosts was so lovely too!!
It felt a bit like the future I've always pictured.. It was lovely to see them tending the space to their own taste, and they looked so happy in a space filled with the things they love that it made me happy too :)
Spending time in a space filled with the hosts' taste also reminded me of something I'd forgotten in my busy everyday life: 'oh right, I used to love this kind of thing too'
It was a time that made Haenggung-dong, which I see so often, look even prettier!
If I get the chance, I'll come again!!

The house is extremely well located for visiting the fortress, the palace and the walls on foot.
Cafés and restaurants are right next to the house.

Yesterday I got to attend the opening ceremony of the Suwon Hwaseong Festival, and at the end of the ceremony we did a lantern walk along the ramparts, topped off with an interactive pansori performance.

My advice: include Suwon in your trip to Korea and spend at least 2 nights there so you have time to really see it.

When I booked I was quite worried because there weren't many reviews, but I fell for one photo of a pretty window and booked it anyway. The window turned out to be even prettier than the photo I'd been looking forward to, and the room was perfectly clean and tidy. The overall atmosphere was quiet and right for resting, and the pretty, gentle cats seemed to contribute a lot to that.
The host couple kindly answered every question, and they kept our luggage before check-in and after check-out so we could look around the area at ease. They also recommended lots of nearby sights, nice walking paths, good restaurants and pretty cafés with tasty desserts, which was great. They recommended so many good places that, if anything, it was a shame we couldn't get to them all. Next time I'd like to give myself a bit more time and visit more of the places they suggested.
The neat breakfast they served in the morning was tidy and delicious, as you'd expect from hosts who used to run a restaurant. Every side dish was perfect, and the dessert even more so. The neatly laid table, the morning atmosphere of the house, the warm host couple and the cats around all came together for a truly perfect start to the day.

체계적인 안내와 배려
체크인 전부터 준비를 철저히 해주셨습니다. 바이브 코딩 등을 활용해 주변 맛집의 위치와 추천 지수까지 상세하게 공유해주셔서 여행에 큰 도움이 되었습니다. 일정상 어려움이 있었으나 감사하게도 얼리 체크인까지 유연하게 도와주셨습니다.

감각적인 인테리어
방 인테리어 하나하나에 신경을 많이 쓰신 게 고스란히 느껴졌습니다. 탁 트인 통창과 감각적인 벽지, 그리고 포근하고 예쁜 침대 이불보 덕분에 머무는 내내 공간이 주는 만족감이 컸습니다.

정성스러운 아침 식사
아침에는 호스트님께서 직접 정갈한 백반을 차려주셨습니다. 정성이 가득 담긴 건강하고 맛있는 아침밥 덕분에 든든하게 하루를 시작할 수 있었습니다.

The host’s philosophy and meaningful conversation

Stylish interior

A breakfast made with care

행궁동에 대한 이해도는 ‘stay eego'에 머무른 전과 후로 나누어집니다.
분명 낯선 장소인데 어느덧 내가 사는 동네처럼 익숙해지고 애정이 생기는 공간이 되었습니다.

숙소에 도착하자마자 정원이 주는 자연의 아름다움에 매료되었고 호스트분들의 친절한 안내와 더불어 편안한 마당 냥이들을 보니 이 장소가 너무나 아늑하게 느껴졌습니다.
아침으로 준비해주신 식사와 디저트도 너무 맛있었고 편안한 시간이었어요.

또한 인스타 맛집이나 그런 곳이 아닌 정말 찐 로컬의 장소들을 알려주셨는데 가는 곳마다 모두 다 너무 마음에 들어서 행궁동에 정말 자주 와야겠다는 생각이 들었습니다.

이번에 정말 돈으로도 살 수 없는 잊지 못할 추억 많이 만들고 갑니다.
조만간 오늘의 추억을 함께 담은 압화 챙겨서 다시 찾아뵙겠습니다☺️ 감사합니다!

My understanding of Haenggung-dong divides into before and after staying at 'stay eego'.
It was definitely an unfamiliar place, yet before I knew it, it had become as familiar as my own neighbourhood, a place I've grown fond of.

The moment we arrived I was captivated by the natural beauty of the garden, and with the hosts' kind welcome and the relaxed yard cats, the place felt so cosy.
The breakfast and dessert they prepared were delicious too, and it was such a relaxing time.

They also told us about places that weren't Instagram-famous spots but truly local ones, and I loved every single place we went, so much that I thought I really need to come to Haenggung-dong often.

I'm leaving with so many unforgettable memories that money can't buy.
I'll come back to see you soon with pressed flowers that hold today's memories ☺️ Thank you!

This place made our spur-of-the-moment trip to Suwon's Haenggung even more perfect.
Its biggest strengths are how calm, comfortable and cosy it is, and the lovely cats.
(The cats are SO cute, really really!)
Music in the shared space and a leisurely cup of coffee,
a warm, cosy room, and a quiet atmosphere because it sits on the edge of Haengridan-gil — all of this is possible because of the two kind hosts, a married couple.
And last, the warmth you can feel even in the breakfast. We hardly ever eat breakfast, but it was so delicious we cleaned our bowls.

Oh! And the real best part: the room is warm and even the bathroom floor is heated. (Hot water too, of course!)
I feel like I've only talked about the good points, but honestly there are only good points (dead serious)

I think we'll probably be back on a warm spring day, which will be here soon👍

갑자기 결정한 아내와의 휴가. 숙소 평점이 너무 좋아 주저없이 선택했는데 기대 이상이었습니다. 호스트가 계신다는 점이 너무 좋았어요. 마치 내 집인듯한 착각이 들어 편안했어요.
함께 나누는 대화들도 하나하나가 소중했던, 깨알같은 현지 정보, 정보를 넘어선 맘 속 이야기까지...

덕분에 서울, 용인에 있는 아이들까지 모여 오붓한 저녁과 함께 행복한 시간을 가졌습니다. 5월에도 화성 방화수류정에 갔는데, 수원에 자주 가게 되네요.
천년고도에 살다 보니 문화재가 있는 곳에 가면 편안해지나봐요. 인생에 멋진 행복의 나이트 하나가 그어졌네요. 다시 뵙기를 고대합니다.

A holiday with my wife, decided on a whim. The ratings were so good that I chose it without hesitation, and it exceeded expectations. I really liked that the hosts are there. It was comfortable, as if it were my own home.
Every conversation we shared was precious — little nuggets of local information, and even heartfelt stories beyond mere information...
The location is right next to Hwaseong Haenggung, so it goes without saying it was convenient; a morning walk begins the moment you step out the door, and there are the Haengridan-gil restaurants all around...
Thanks to that, our children, who live in Seoul and Yongin, came too, and we had a cosy dinner and a happy time together. In May we also went to Banghwasuryujeong at Hwaseong — we find ourselves coming to Suwon often.
Having lived in a thousand-year-old capital, I suppose I feel at ease in places with cultural heritage. A wonderful line of happiness has been drawn in my life. I look forward to seeing you again.

평소 행궁동을 좋아해서 자주 놀러가곤 하는데, 이번 연휴를 기회삼아 행궁동을 제대로 느껴보기로 했습니다. 여러 후기들 중 조식을 준다는 것과, 사람 냄새 난다는 글에 마음이 가서 예약하게 되었습니다.

결론적으로 너무나 만족한 여행이었습니다. 위치도 너무 좋았고, 저녁에 사장님과 간단하게 이야기 나누며 추천 받았던 가게들도 너무 좋았습니다. 어릴 때부터 이 건물에서 살아왔다고 말씀하시는데, 행궁동에 대한 사랑이 깊게 느껴졌습니다. 호텔에서는 절대 느낄 수 없는, 로컬 숙소에서만 느낄 수 있는 낭만있는 하루였습니다.

새해를 맞이해 이런 경험을 하게 되어 호스트분께 너무 감사드리며, 지친 하루 힐링해준 고양이 시루에게도 감사 말씀 드립니다.

I love Haenggung-dong and often go there to hang out, so I took the opportunity of this holiday to really experience it properly. Among all the reviews, the ones saying they serve breakfast and that the place has a real human warmth won me over, so I booked.

In the end, it was an incredibly satisfying trip. The location was great, and the places the owner recommended during a short chat in the evening were all wonderful too. The owner said they’ve lived in this building since he was a child, and I could feel how deeply they love Haenggung-dong. It was a romantic day you could never get at a hotel, only at a local place to stay.

I’m so grateful to the hosts for this experience to welcome in the new year, and I’d also like to thank Siru the cat for healing me after a tiring day.

Hi＊okazu★★★★★ March 2026 · Garden room

近隣の飲食店の詳細を教えていただき、また味の好みが合いとても美味しい食事ができました。
周辺はカフェやデザート店、コンビニエンスストアが多く困りません。
徒歩等で10分〜15分程度で歴史ある韓国料理が味わえる食堂がたくさん軒を並べています。(キンパ、サムゲタン、冷麺、カルビ焼肉、チゲ、チキン、マンドゥなど)
特筆すべきはホストから提供される韓国スタイルの朝ごはんです。手作りのおかず、焼きたての卵焼きはとても美味しいです。
お部屋もとてもかわいく、センスのあるお部屋でした。韓国は床暖房があるのでとても暖かく過ごす事が出来ました。

周囲は歴史ある建物が多く城壁の周りの散歩や散策を楽しむ事ができました。

とにかく食べて散策をしてホストと楽しいコミュニケーションがとるとこができてまた訪問したいと思います。

They told me all about the restaurants nearby, and they suited my taste perfectly, so I had some really delicious meals.
There are lots of cafés, dessert shops and convenience stores around, so you won’t want for anything.
Within about a 10–15 minute walk, there are rows of eateries where you can taste Korean food with a long history. (Gimbap, samgyetang, naengmyeon, galbi barbecue, jjigae, chicken, mandu and more)
What really deserves a special mention is the Korean-style breakfast the host provides. The homemade side dishes and freshly cooked rolled omelette are delicious.
The room was also really cute and stylish. Korea has underfloor heating, so I stayed very warm.

There are many historic buildings around, and I enjoyed strolling and exploring along the fortress walls.

All in all, I got to eat, explore and have lovely conversations with the hosts, and I’d like to visit again.

인＊★★★★★ March 2024 · Alley room

위치 - 행궁동 번화가와 가까워 드나듬이 편리했고, 골목 안쪽에 위치해 소음은 전혀 없었습니다.

청결 - 아주 만족. 어메니티, 소품, 침구류 하나하나 좋은 제품들로만 준비해 주셔서 정보 잔뜩 얻어왔습니다.

조식 - 정성이 잔뜩 들어간 반찬들, 국과 밥까지 집밥먹는 느낌이고, 간이 세지 않아서 만족한 식사였습니다

호스트 - 행궁동에 애정을 갖고있는 두분의 모습이 너무 보기좋았습니다. 행궁을 가까이 느낄 수 있는 곳들 위주로 추천해주셔서 머물러있는동안 어디 갈지 고민하지 않아도 돼서 좋았습니다.

기타 - 고양이들이 귀여웠고, 수다타임이 즐거웠고, 대화만으로도 위로가 되는 두분의 다정함이 너무 소중한 하루였습니다 감사합니다.

Location – Close to Haenggung-dong's busy streets, so it was easy to come and go, and tucked into an alley, so there was no noise at all.

Cleanliness – Very satisfied. Every amenity, decorative touch and piece of bedding was a quality product, so I came away with loads of tips.

Breakfast – Side dishes made with real care, plus soup and rice: it felt like a home-cooked meal, and it wasn't heavily seasoned, so I really enjoyed it

Hosts – It was so lovely to see how much the two of them love Haenggung-dong. They mostly recommended places where you can feel Haenggung up close, so I didn't have to worry about where to go during the stay.

Other – The cats were cute, chat time was fun, and the kindness of the two hosts, comforting just to talk with, made it such a precious day. Thank you.

최근 다녀온 에어비앤비 중 가장 만족도 높은 장소였습니다. 여행을 좋아하는 우리 부부는 자주 에어비앤비를 이용하지만 이토록 만족스러운 공간을 찾기는 어려울 것 같습니다. 정갈한 반상 조식이 제공되는데 그 시간이 수원 여행을 완성하는 마지막 조각인 것 같았어요. 호스트가 나눠주려고 하는' 스테이 이고'의 이야기와 대화에서 느껴지는 수원에 대한 짙은 애정이 지금의 '이고'를 만들었지 않나 생각했습니다. 일정 때문에 김밥을 못 먹고 온 것이 가장 아쉽네요. 추천해주신 카페들도 하나같이 제가 원하는 감도와 같아 그 중 한 곳을 어렵게 골라 시간을 보냈습니다. 더운 여름이 오기 전에 다시 한번 수원에 방문하고 싶습니다!!

Of all the Airbnbs we’ve stayed at recently, this was the most satisfying. We’re a couple who love to travel and use Airbnb often, but I think it’ll be hard to find a space this satisfying again. They serve a neat, traditional Korean set breakfast, and that time felt like the final piece that completed our Suwon trip. I thought the story of ‘Stay Eego’ that the hosts want to share, and the deep love for Suwon you feel in conversation with them, must be what made ‘Eego’ what it is today. My biggest regret is that we couldn’t have the gimbap because of our schedule. The cafés they recommended were all exactly my kind of vibe, so it was hard to pick just one to spend time at. I want to visit Suwon again before the hot summer comes!!

주변도 조용하고 너무 좋았어요
방에서 보이는 정원뷰 귀여운고양이들 바라보고 있으면 힐링되는 기분입니다
멍때리게 되요
주변에 산책할수 있는곳이 많아서 아침에
여기저기 선택해서 다녔어요
사장님 부부가 맛집과 카페도 친절하게 추천해주셨어요
아침식사와 후식도 너무 맜있어요
몇일 편안하게 책도 보고 산책도 하고
여기저기 돌아다니면서 잘 지냈어요
다시 올거예요~

There was a problem at home so I was looking for somewhere to stay
and booked because it was pretty
Just like the photos, the room and bathroom were both so clean
and the area was quiet, I loved it
Looking out from the room at the garden view and the cute cats feels so healing
You end up just zoning out
There are lots of places to walk nearby, so in the mornings
I picked a different spot each time
The owner couple kindly recommended good restaurants and cafés
Breakfast and dessert were so delicious too
For a few days I read books in comfort, went for walks
and wandered here and there, and had a lovely time
I'll be back~

마당 정원이 정말 예쁘고 평화롭고 그냥 눌러앉고 살고 싶은 숙소였습니다.

The garden in the yard is so pretty and peaceful – it's a place where I just wanted to settle in and live.
You know how when people do a 'hotel staycation', there's so much to do even if you never leave the hotel? For me, this was exactly that kind of place. Just reading the books in the house while looking out the window from my room was so healing. There's a convenience store nearby, and Haenggung street is right outside, so it's great for wandering around. It was clean, and the hosts have great taste in interiors too. I'm writing this back at home and I already want to go again. It really feels like I've been dreaming.

欣＊★★★★★ October 2024 · Garden room

民宿就在水原华城旁边，一走出来就是咖啡店、商店、餐厅，非常方便！距离我们想要去的地方都在步行三十分钟圈内，很舒服很适合散步。房东夫妇人非常热情友好，到达的时候已经过凌晨十二点了，他们非常亲切出来帮我们拿行李，第二天起来准备了非常韩式的早餐，很漂亮也很好吃。喜欢他们家的庭院，有非常多的小猫，窗外的树上还有很多小鸟飞来飞去的，特别惬意。家里还养了一只胖胖的小猫，特别可爱亲人！我们订的车票需要很早离开，他们还为我们准备了路上可以吃的早餐和水，非常宾至如归的一次体验，非常感谢🙏

The place is right next to Hwaseong Fortress — step outside and there are cafés, shops and restaurants, super convenient! Everywhere we wanted to go was within a thirty-minute walk, really comfortable and perfect for strolling. The host couple were very warm and friendly. It was already past midnight when we arrived, but they kindly came out to help with our luggage, and the next morning they’d prepared a very Korean breakfast, so pretty and delicious. I loved their garden — lots of little cats, and little birds flying around in the trees outside the window, so relaxing. They also have a chubby cat at home, so cute and so friendly! Our train tickets meant we had to leave very early, and they even prepared breakfast and water for us to take on the way. It truly felt like home. Thank you so much 🙏
